R6M-grouse-drive-0001.name: 2.2 km S of Smokee Lake
R6M-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6M-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Damsumlo FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
10 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Kuldo, about 16 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Kuldo FSR, Damsumlo FSR.
Park: 55.9366, -127.83546, pull off on Damsumlo FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Damsumlo FSR stretch, 4.9 km one way. About 98 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-7, Region 6. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 51, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-16, closures 2026-10-16.
R6M-grouse-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-7: about 174 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.04 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
